tgt: Korende bono morigetie kong'ita, ninche oyo nabateebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Aburaamu takorete igo.

src: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.
tgt: Tibagosemeria ebisasimero ebire emeremo y'amaboko abo, gose tibakorigereria emete eteneneirie Asera, enyasae yabo enkuungu, gose ebisasimero bi'ogosambera ubani, ebi baroisirie nebiara biabo.

src: You were running so well. Who has obstructed you from obeying the truth?
tgt: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?

src: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater), has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
tgt: Inaki ring’ana eri mwarimanyire kegima, ng’a omotomani, gose oyo otachenegeti, gose omonto omwegimeria (engencho yaye omosasiimi emegwekano) takonyora omwando ase oborwoti bwa Kristo na Nyasae. Taara buna abana b’omobaso

src: Those who were within, trusting in the strength of the walls and their store of provisions, behaved themselves rudely toward Judas and those who were with him, railing, and furthermore blaspheming and speaking impious words.
tgt: Abamenyi b'omochie oyio nigo begenete chinyasi chi'omochie obo, na nigo babwate ogosemeria buna endagera eyio bagachete nabo yare kobaisana ase amatuko aria onsi baboereire. Ase igo bagachecheria Yuda n'abanto baye na korama Nyasae.

src: Wale waliokuwa ndani, wakitumaini nguvu za kuta na akiba yao ya vyakula, walijitendea kwa ukali dhidi ya Yuda na wale waliokuwa pamoja naye, wakimtukana, na zaidi ya hayo, wakimkufuru na kusema maneno machafu.
tgt: Abamenyi b'omochie oyio nigo begenete chinyasi chi'omochie obo, na nigo babwate ogosemeria buna endagera eyio bagachete nabo yare kobaisana ase amatuko aria onsi baboereire. Ase igo bagachecheria Yuda n'abanto baye na korama Nyasae.

src: Who led them through the depths, like a horse in the wilderness, so that they didn't stumble?
tgt: Ere akabaetia ase chindiba ime buna chibarasi chigoeta ase erooro, barabwo tibagochetwe aande.”

src: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
tgt: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).

src: Pamoja na ndugu zao wote walikuwa wamefundishwa na kuwa stadi wa uimbaji kwa Bwana. Idadi yao walikuwa 288.
tgt: Omobaro obo amo nabaanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete goteera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).

src: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
tgt: Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.

src: As for the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, along with all his accomplishments, they are indeed written in the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel. Pekah Reigns in Israel
tgt: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Pekahia, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Peka omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli

src: Matukio mengine ya utawala wa Pekahia na yote aliyoyafanya yameandikwa katika kitabu cha kumbukumbu za wafalme wa Israeli. Peka Mfalme Wa Israeli
tgt: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Pekahia, na aya onsi akorete, nigo ariikire ase Egetabu ki’ogokora kw’Abarwoti b’Abaisraeli. Peka omorwoti bw’Abaisraeli

src: After the Holy Spirit had prevented them from speaking the word in the province of Asia, they traveled through the region of Phrygia and Galatia.
tgt: Paulo na Timotheo bagaeta ase ense ya Furugia na Galatia, ekiagera bakanetigwe n’Omoika Omochenu ng’a tibarandia ring’ana agwo ase ense y’Asia.

src: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.
tgt: Tiga omochie obo otigare bosa, monto onde tamenya ase chiema chiabo.

src: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”
tgt: Emeganda eria yatang'aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri'Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro mono!”

src: Ule umati wa watu uliomtangulia na ule uliomfuata ukapiga kelele ukisema, “Hosana, Mwana wa Daudi!” “Amebarikiwa yeye ajaye kwa Jina la Bwana!” “Hosana juu mbinguni!”
tgt: Emeganda eria yatang'aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateeba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri'Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro mono!”

src: They cried aloud toward heaven, saying, “What should we do with these men? Where should we carry them away?
tgt: Bono omosangererekano bwonsi ogasaba ase eriogi bagoteeba: “Ninki tokobakorera abatakerwa aba? Ng'ai tokobaira bono?

src: Walipiga kelele kwa sauti kubwa kuelekea mbinguni, wakisema, "Tuwafanye nini watu hawa? Tuwapeleke wapi?"
tgt: Bono omosangererekano bwonsi ogasaba ase eriogi bagoteeba: “Ninki tokobakorera abatakerwa aba? Ng'ai tokobaira bono?

src: For from within the hearts of men come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,
tgt: Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’ abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,

src: the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. They may dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know of any talented men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.”
tgt: Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.” Yakobo ase obosio bwa Farao

src: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with iniquity.
tgt: Nigo mogendererete koagacha Yerusalemu omochie omonene o Nyasae, ase oboroso bw’ogoita n’borimo.

src: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the level. Hail will sweep away your refuge of lies, and water will flood your hiding place.
tgt: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”

src: Nitaifanya haki kuwa kamba ya kupimia na uadilifu kuwa timazi; mvua ya mawe itafagia kimbilio lenu, huo uongo, nayo maji yatafurikia mahali penu pa kujificha.
tgt: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”

src: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,
tgt: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;

src: Hizi ndizo sadaka utakazozipokea kutoka kwao: dhahabu, fedha na shaba;
tgt: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa ase bare nabio ebi: chitaabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;

src: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat?” says Yahweh.
tgt: Omobani oria obwate chindoto, tiga achikwane, korende oyobwate ring'ana riane, tiga arikwane ase obwegenwa. Inee! Omoiriro, ninki oisaine ekero okoreng'anigwa nengano? Nabo inche Omonene natebiire.

src: Therefore Yahweh says: “You have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor. Behold, I proclaim to you a liberty,” says Yahweh, “to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine. I will make you be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
tgt: Ase ayio, aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Inwe mwangire konyigwera, na koraria obosibore kera omonto ase oyomwabo, na ase omogisangio oye. Rora inche nkobaa nde inwe obosibore bwaino; obosibore obwo nabwo obo: Nigo moraitwe nemioro, na oborwaire bogoita, na enchara. Na amarwoti onsi ay'ense naondoke ase engencho y'amang'ana ayio ndabakorere inwe.

src: “Kwa hiyo, hili ndilo asemalo Bwana: Hamkunitii mimi. Hamkutangaza uhuru kwa ndugu zenu. Hivyo sasa, ninawatangazia ninyi ‘uhuru,' asema Bwana: ‘uhuru' ili kuanguka kwa upanga, tauni na njaa. Nitawafanya mwe chukizo kwa falme zote za dunia.
tgt: Ase ayio, aya nar'Omonene agoteeba: Inwe mwangire konyigwera, na koraria obosibore kera omonto ase oyomwabo, na ase omogisangio oye. Rora inche nkobaa nde inwe obosibore bwaino; obosibore obwo nabwo obo: Nigo moraitwe nemioro, na oborwaire bogoita, na enchara. Na amarwoti onsi ay'ense naondoke ase engencho y'amang'ana ayio ndabakorere inwe.

src: “Am I only a God nearby,” declares the LORD, “and not a God far away?”
tgt: “Inee! Inche nigo inde Nyasae ore ang’e rioka? Tindi Nyasae ore aare boigo?

src: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.
tgt: ebirandi biaye biichire namabeere, na amauga 'omobere oye aichire nemeseto.

src: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders receive no respect.
tgt: Abagaambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.

src: Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph in the land of Egypt by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
tgt: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.

src: Huko Misri, Asenathi binti wa Potifera, aliyekuwa kuhani wa mji wa Oni, alimzalia Yosefu wana wawili, Manase na Efraimu.
tgt: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, Omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.

src: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
tgt: Abanto mbakoiroke, koreng'ana buna erioba na omotienyi bigendererete kobao, ebiaare ase ebiaare.

src: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.
tgt: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.

src: I ate no rich food, no meat or wine entered my mouth, and I did not anoint myself with oil until the three weeks were completed.
tgt: Tinarenge koria endagera engiya, gose koria enyama, gose konywa edivai. Tinarenge kweaka amaguta nonya ng’ake ase chichuma chiria isato.

src: Sikula chakula kizuri; nyama wala divai havikugusa midomo yangu; nami sikujipaka mafuta kamwe mpaka majuma matatu yalipotimia.
tgt: Tinarenge koria endagera engiya, gose koria enyama, gose konywa edivai. Tinarenge kweaka amaguta nonya ng’ake ase chichuma chiria isato.

src: From Benjamin, the kinsmen of Saul: 3,000, most of whom had remained loyal to the house of Saul up to that time.
tgt: Ababenjamini, abanto b’eamate ya Saulo, nigo barenge chilifu isato (3,000), nonya nase ekero ekio abange mono kobua b’abwo bagendererete kobwatana nenyomba ya Saulo.

src: You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
tgt: Aye omonga’inereria, rusia ritang’ani omoriibo ore ase eriiso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriiso ri’oyomino.

src: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
tgt: Erio Abimeleki akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, amo nabasomba, abamura na abaiseke, akaa Aburaamu, akamoiraneria na Sara mokaye.

src: Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada sent for the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, and the guards, and had them brought into the house of the LORD. There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son
tgt: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, Yehoyada agatoma amang’ana korenta abatang’ani b’abarendi amagana b’omorwoti, na ab’enyomba y’omorwoti, akabairana ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, na akagera bakaria chimuma agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene. Erio akaborokia omwana oria bw’omorwoti.

src: O inhabitant of Lebanon, nestled in the cedars, how you will groan when pangs of anguish come upon you, agony like a woman in labor.” A Warning to Coniah
tgt: Inwe abanto ba Lebanoni, mwabeire more n’obotoereru ase ebiswa biaino ime, ase egati y’emecharake. Ekeene, namweumie ekero moraigwe obororo, obororo buna obw’omokuungu okobina aibore. Ekiina kia Nyasae igoro ya Konia

src: Suddenly two men, Moses and Elijah, began talking with Jesus.
tgt: Na agwo, abanto babere bakarorekana bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.

src: They gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are mentioned by name:
tgt: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simioni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.

src: When the Israelites saw it, they asked one another, “What is it?” For they did not know what it was. So Moses told them, “It is the bread that the LORD has given you to eat.
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.

src: Waisraeli walipoona, wakaambiana, “Hiki ni nini?” Kwa kuwa hawakujua kilikuwa kitu gani. Mose akawaambia, “Huu ndio mkate ambao Bwana amewapa mle.
tgt: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabateebia, “Oria nomogati oy’Omonene abaeire morie.

src: And the people implored the Lord Most High, in prayer before him who is merciful, until the worship of the Lord was finished, and so they accomplished his service.
tgt: Erio abanto bakamogaramera Omonene kegima, bakamosaba ere omonyene amaabera goika omoroberio bw'okomosasiima Omonene okaera. Naboigo banyaarete gokora okomosasiima ere.

src: Nao watu wakamwomba Bwana Aliye Juu Zaidi, wakimwomba Yeye aliye na huruma, hata ibada ya Bwana ikamilike, nao wakakamilisha huduma yake.
tgt: Erio abanto bakamogaramera Omonene kegima, bakamosaba ere omonyene amaabera goika omoroberio bw'okomosasiima Omonene okaera. Naboigo banyaarete gokora okomosasiima ere.

src: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.
tgt: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng'a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

src: Kwa kuwa alitambua Yesu alikuwa amekabidhiwa kwake kwa ajili ya wivu.
tgt: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng'a Abayahudi nigo baruete Yeso ase obogechi.

src: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”
tgt: Yeso akamoteebia, “Naboigo aye gwateebire, korende nabateebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana-o-Mwanyabaanto oikaransete ensemo y'okoboko gw'okorio kw'Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”

src: An evil man is trapped by his rebellious speech, but a righteous man escapes from trouble.
tgt: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa n’ogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.

src: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
tgt: Omonto oria orasaambe ebinto ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namaache; magega y'ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.

src: who tell the seers, “Don't see!” and the prophets, “Don't prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.
tgt: Nigo bagoteebia abarori b'amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang'ana,” na bateebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobaanera amang'ana amaronge; toteebie amang'ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobaanere ay'obong'ainereria.

src: Woe to the majestic crown of Ephraim’s drunkards, to the fading flower of his glorious splendor, set on the summit above the fertile valley, the pride of those overcome by wine.
tgt: Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abaanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.

src: In those days Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim
tgt: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omorwoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omorwoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omorwoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omorwoti o Goiimu,

src: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
tgt: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.

src: He built the upper gate of Yahweh's house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.
tgt: Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki'enyomba y'Omonene, naende agakora emeremo emenene ase okoagacha orwaki rw'Ofeli.

src: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
tgt: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo baarenge abagaambi korwa ase ororeeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.

src: But as for ourselves, many afflictions and many wars have encompassed us, and the kings who are around us have fought against us.
tgt: Korende intwe twabeire togotwara obokong'u ne emechando boigo chiseegi kera engaki, ase engencho ebisaku bitoetanaine biabeire bigotorwania.

src: Lakini sisi wenyewe, mateso mengi na vita vingi vimetuzunguka, na wafalme walio karibu nasi wamepigana nasi.
tgt: Korende intwe twabeire togotwara obokong'u ne emechando boigo chiseegi kera engaki, ase engencho ebisaku bitoetanaine biabeire bigotorwania.

src: Jerusalem has grievously sinned. Therefore she has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness. Yes, she sighs and turns backward.
tgt: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi abaabasigete baabachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia magega.

src: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);
tgt: Mwarooche ebinto babwate bi'okogeechia, emegwekano yabo baare gosasiima, yaroisirie korwa ase emete, n'amagena, ne'chifeta, ne'chitaabu, eyio yarenge ase egati yabo.

src: Then Samson said: “With the jawbone of a donkey I have piled them into heaps. With the jawbone of a donkey I have slain a thousand men.”
tgt: Erio Samusoni agakwana. “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababeekire inse ebinge chiebitondo.”

src: Ndipo Samsoni akasema, “Kwa taya la punda malundo juu ya malundo. Kwa taya la punda nimeua watu 1,000.”
tgt: Erio Samusoni agakwana. “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababeekire inse ebinge chiebitondo.”

src: Then they turned back to invade En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
tgt: Erio bakairana goika bagaika Enimisifati, noro okorokwa Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaameleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni-Tamari.

src: In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were evening!’ and in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’—because of the dread in your hearts of the terrifying sights you will see.
tgt: Ase engencho y’omoondoko bwe chinkoro chiraabe n’obwoba, na ase amakumia y’okoirokia, na ase aria morarore n’amaiso aino, nigo morateebe ase engaki ya mambia: ’Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mogoroba, na ase engaki ya mogoroba moteebe: Naki y’are koba buya onye yaaba mambia.

src: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
tgt: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.

src: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
tgt: Daudi akenyorera erieta rinene ekero arenge koirana, gaitire Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano’isato (18,000) ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.

src: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
tgt: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene bw'Emeganda nabe egutwa y'obonene, na ekiore ki'obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

src: Katika siku ile, Bwana Mwenye Nguvu Zote atakuwa taji la utukufu, taji zuri la maua kwa mabaki ya watu wake.
tgt: Ase engaki eyi'Omonene bw'Emeganda nabe egutwa y'obonene, na ekiore ki'obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,

src: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

src: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words,

src: May the LORD repay every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. For the LORD delivered you into my hand today, but I would not stretch out my hand against the LORD’s anointed.
tgt: Omonene nigo agoakana kera omonto buna oboronge bwaye bore, na obwegenwa boigo. Ase rituko ria rero Omonene nigo akobeka ase okoboko kwane, korende naanga korambora okoboko kwane igoro ase omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.

src: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
tgt: Ekero amang'ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateeba ng'a tinkobugwa.

src: Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them, and fled by the way of the wilderness.
tgt: Yoshua amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bagekora buna babuirwe, bagatama gochia erooro.

src: Yoshua na Israeli wote wakaruhusu kurudishwa nyuma mbele yao, na kuelekea jangwani.
tgt: Yoshua amo n'Abaisraeli bonsi bagekora buna babuirwe, bagatama gochia erooro.

src: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, yes, I will give all the treasures of the kings of Judah into the hand of their enemies. They will make them captives, take them, and carry them to Babylon.
tgt: Nindue obotenenku bw'omochie oyio, ne chinibo chiaye chionsi, na ebinto bi'amagori amanene bireo ne chikungo chionsi chi'abarwoti b'Abayuda, mbibeeke ase amaboko 'ababisa babo, na abwo babisakore na kobiira Babiloni.

src: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
tgt: Na onye Kristo tabogetigwe, okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa; nigo more nonya mbono ase ebibe biaino.

src: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of the First and the Last, who died and returned to life.
tgt: Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Sumurina riika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyore bw’eritang’ani na oyo bw’omoerio, oyo konya okuure, naende akaba moyo.

src: I encountered the watchmen on their rounds of the city: “Have you seen the one I love?”
tgt: Ekero abarendi barenge goetanana omochie koyorata, bakanyoora inche, na inche nkababooria, “Mwarora omwanchi bw’omoyo one?”

src: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);
tgt: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose motaari onde tabeete okorara isiko botuko.

src: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.
tgt: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng'a n'Yeso.

src: I know a man in Christ who fourteen years ago was caught up to the third heaven. Whether it was in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows.
tgt: Namanyire omonto oyomo ase Kristo, yaetire emiaka ikomi na ene, omonto oyio akabogorigwa gochia igoro ya gatato, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete).

src: She treats her young harshly, as if not her own, with no concern that her labor was in vain.
tgt: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,

src: Yeye huyafanyia makinda yake ukatili kama vile si yake; hajali kwamba taabu yake inaweza ikawa bure,
tgt: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,

src: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
tgt: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe omwando obo, na barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw’omorembe.

src: Bali wanyenyekevu watairithi nchi na wafurahie amani tele.
tgt: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe omwando obo, na barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw’omorembe.

src: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.
tgt: Korende onye more ne ribero rire nobororo, na okweancha ase chinkoro chiaino ime, timwetogia na gokwana oborimo igoro y'ekeene.

src: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
tgt: Aye ogatiira gochia igoro ogoosa abasibwa, na okanyora ebiegwa ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto, ee, nonya nase egati y'abasaria, ng'a aye Omonene Nyasae onyare komenya aroro.

src: You must not eat anything with blood still in it. You must not practice divination or sorcery.
tgt: “Timobaisa koria enyama ende yonsi ebwate amanyinga ime yaye. Timobaisa gwancha oboragori, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.

src: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”
tgt: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabatianera bokong'u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang'ana aya.”

src: No one shall come up with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain. Do not let the flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain.”
tgt: Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching'ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang'e negetunwa eke.”

src: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.
tgt: Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochiika abamura baye amang'ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeeka borere igoro; erio agakwa, erio agasangererekana amo nabaanto baye.

src: The border turned around it on the north to Hannathon; and it ended at the valley of Iphtah El;
tgt: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.

src: I won't hide my face from them any more, for I have poured out my Spirit on the house of Israel,' says the Lord Yahweh.”
tgt: Bono tinkobisa obosio bwane naende korwa ase bare. Ning'umore omoika one igoro y'Abaisraeli. Nabo Omonene ateebire.”

src: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and exact from him a tax of grain, you will never live in the stone houses you have built; you will never drink the wine from the lush vineyards you have planted.
tgt: Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana mwatindacheire abataka inse na kobaura engano yabo ebe ebango, nebe ekero moraagache chinyomba chi’amagena abaachire, timogochimenya, na ekero morasimeke emesabibu ase emegondo emiya, timokonywa edivai yaye.

src: I will scatter toward every wind all who are around him to help him, and all his bands. I will draw out the sword after them.
tgt: Ninsiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi abanto bonsi abamoetanaine ase okomokonya, na abarwani baye bonsi b'esegi boigo, naende nimbabwatie n'omoro one.

src: Then Belshazzar gave the command, and they clothed Daniel in purple, placed a gold chain around his neck, and proclaimed him the third highest ruler in the kingdom.
tgt: Erio Belisasari akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli abeekerwe eanga emonyinga, ne chisonoi chi’echitaabu igoti riaye, na ararigwe ng’a ere nomogambi o gatato ase obogambi obo.

src: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
tgt: Gaki bono rora, nkogenda nde Yerusalemu, nasibirwe n'Omoika. Timanyeti ayarachie konyoora aaria,

src: Or why was I not hidden like a stillborn child, like an infant who never sees daylight?
tgt: Nigo nanga nabeete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.

src: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
tgt: Omogwekano bw'amang'ana aya nebatiso, eyekobatooria inwe bono, tari ase okobeeka aare riko ri'omobere, korende ase okoiraneria Nyasae enkoro etari kobagambia, goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo,

src: Therefore show respect for my words; for it is not good to retain every kind of shame. Not everything is approved by all in good faith.
tgt: Aye oyasike amang'ana aane; ekiagera teri buya orore obosooku ase kera egento na tari kera egento kegwancherwa na kera omonto.

src: Kwa hivyo heshimu maneno yangu; kwa maana si vizuri kubaki na kila aina ya aibu. Sio kila kitu kinachokubaliwa na wote kwa nia njema.
tgt: Aye oyasike amang'ana aane; ekiagera teri buya orore obosooku ase kera egento na tari kera egento kegwancherwa na kera omonto.

src: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
tgt: Ase rituko rie ritang'ani, ri'omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Ezra Omokuani akarenta Egetabu ekio ki'Amachiko ase omoganda bwonsi, abasacha na abakungu, nabwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya aya baigwete.

src: Yet a righteous one holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.
tgt: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.

src: For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
tgt: Ogosaria gwaito kwamentekanire na kwabuchire ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito biatobereire birori. Ogosaria gwaito nigo kore amo naintwe, twamanyire obobe bwaito.

src: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.
tgt: Amoni nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ebere agwo Yerusalemu.

src: My son, in your sickness don't be negligent, but pray to the Lord, and he will heal you.
tgt: Aye omwana one, ekero orarware tobaisa koba omworo ase engencho yoborwaire, korende omosabe Omonene nere nakogwenie.

src: Mwanangu, katika ugonjwa wako usiwe mzembe, bali mwombe Bwana, naye atakuponya.
tgt: Aye omwana one, ekero orarware tobaisa koba omworo ase engencho yoborwaire, korende omosabe Omonene nere nakogwenie.

src: Turn Your gaze away from me, that I may again be cheered before I depart and am no more.”
tgt: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

src: Tazama mbali nami, ili niweze kufurahi tena kabla sijaondoka na nisiwepo tena.”
tgt: Intige, inyore chinguru chinyia ntararua ase ense, na ntabeo naende.

src: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, Yahweh.
tgt: Aye Omonene, koreng'ana ne ring'ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.

src: Just then a synagogue leader named Jairus came and fell at Jesus’ feet. He begged Him to come to his house,
tgt: Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,

src: “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
tgt: “Aye amo n’Eleazari Omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto abooswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.

src: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
tgt: Ahasi omorwoti akabutora emetobwa y'ebibekerero bi'ebituba, akarusia ebituba korwa aroro, akarusia negetuba keria ekenene giaterekereretwe igoro ase emegwekano ye chiombe yaroisirie korwa ase etai akageterekerera inse aase atichire namagena.

src: The Israelites set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
tgt: Abaisraeli bakarua Ramesesi, bakageenda Sukoti, bagatoora aroro.

src: those who had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and those who hoarded up silver and gold, in which people trust, and of their getting there is no end?
tgt: Ng'ai bare baria baroberetie na gwechanda korigia enibo abwo emeremo yabo etatigete kemanyererio kende?

tgt: Ng'ai bare baria baroberetie na gwechanda korigia enibo abwo emeremo yabo etatigete kemanyererio kende?

src: Now there were four leprous men at the entrance of the gate. They said to one another, “Why do we sit here until we die?
tgt: Bono abanto baane barwarete oborwaire bwa ukoma mbaarenge agwo ase egesoero ki'egeita. Barabwo bagateebania: “Ninki gekogera toikaranse aiga goika tokwe?

src: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
tgt: Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyomenyete ase egati yao, nigo are omorwani etuoni okogotooria. Ere nigo akogokerete nomogooko omonene. Nabe okirete‐kiri ore nobwanchani bwaye; akogokere nogoteera kw'omogooko.

src: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;
tgt: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi.

src: by the God of your father who helps you, and by the Almighty who blesses you, with blessings of the heavens above, with blessings of the depths below, with blessings of the breasts and womb.
tgt: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omobui, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.

src: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

tgt: Omokuani akaa abatang’ani baria amatimo ne chinguba chiria chiarenge echi’omorwoti Daudi; ebinto ebio biarenge ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.

src: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.
tgt: Emegwekano yabo bagosasiima moyesambe n'omorero. Timogania koira chifeta gose chitaabu chire ase emegwekano eyio. Moise gochigania nigo chiraabe chikobatega. Ayio onsi nigo arabe okogeechia ase Omonene Nyasae oino.

src: They answered, “Come on, let us go up against them, for we have seen the land, and it is very good. Why would you fail to act? Do not hesitate to go there and take possession of the land!
tgt: Bakairaneria, “Imoka, togende korwania abanto baria, ekiagera ntwarora ense eria, ng’a n’engiya mono. Inaki mogoikaransa aa bosa? Timobaisa goteeba na kogeenda aroro na koira ense eria.

src: “Son of man, when the house of Israel lived in their own land, they defiled it by their ways and by their deeds. Their way before me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
tgt: Aye Mwanyabaanto, ekero Abaisraeli bamenyete ase ense yabo, bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti goetera ase chinchera chiabo na ogokora kwabo, ekiagera ogokora kwabo nigo kwabete ase obosio bwane buna ogotacheneka kw'omokuungu, ekero are nomotienyi.

src: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
tgt: Ee, oyio noro omogooko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.

src: containing the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
tgt: Ime aroro mbiarengeo egesasiimero gi’etaabu ki’ogosambera ubani, na esanduki y’okobwatana yaoomire netaabu chinsemo chionsi. Ime ase esanduki eria mbiarengeo: Egetaabo gi’etaabu aase biabegetwe endagera yare korokwa mana, na enyimbo ya Aroni yasebogete, ne chibao chi’amagena aase amang’ana okobwatana kw’ogotianania ariikire.

src: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”
tgt: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y' abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”

src: Mtawala atakuja kutoka kwa Yakobo na kuangamiza walionusurika katika mji.”
tgt: Omogambi naoroke korwa ase egati y' abanto ba Yakobo asirie abanto batameire emechie banyore oborendi.”

src: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touches any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”
tgt: Naende Hagai akaboria, “Onye omonto obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo karakune ekemo ase ebinto ebio, Inee, ekio nakebe egetachenegeti?” Abakuani bakairaneria, bagateeba, “Ee, nkebe egetachenegeti.”

src: with a crown of gold upon the mitre, having engraved on it, as on a signet, “HOLINESS”, an ornament of honor, the work of an expert, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.
tgt: Korwa ase oroiboro rwa Yakobo akamoorokia omonto obwate ogwancherwa ase abanto bonsi, ere aganchwa n'Omonene boigo na abanto bonsi. Oyio nere Musa tokogoka komoinyora.

src: na taji ya dhahabu juu ya kilemba, ikiwa imechorwa juu yake, kama kwenye muhuri, "UTAKATIFU", pambo la heshima, kazi ya mtaalamu, tamaa za macho, nzuri na nzuri.
tgt: Korwa ase oroiboro rwa Yakobo akamoorokia omonto obwate ogwancherwa ase abanto bonsi, ere aganchwa n'Omonene boigo na abanto bonsi. Oyio nere Musa tokogoka komoinyora.

src: but don't think that you will be unpunished, having tried to fight against God!”
tgt: Korende tokagera buna aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y'okoamererania na Nyasae.”

src: lakini usidhani kwamba hutaadhibiwa, kwa kuwa umejaribu kupigana na Mungu!
tgt: Korende tokagera buna aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y'okoamererania na Nyasae.”

src: For Yahweh your God brings you into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of springs, and underground water flowing into valleys and hills;
tgt: Omonene Nyasae oino, 'nkobaira are ase ense engiya ebwate chindooche ne'chinsooko, ne'chintuboka chigosookia amaache gochia ase amagoko na ase ebitunwa.

src: You are not to do as we are doing here today, where everyone does what seems right in his own eyes.
tgt: “Ase ekero keria timobaisa gokora buna togokora bono aiga. Kera omonto nigo agokora buna arooche omonyene ng’a ’mboronge.

src: Msifanye kama tunavyofanya hapa leo, kila mtu anavyopenda mwenyewe,
tgt: “Ase ekero keria timobaisa gokora buna togokora bono aiga. Kera omonto nigo agokora buna arooche omonyene ng’a ’mboronge.

src: As for their rims, they were high and dreadful; and the four of them had their rims full of eyes all around.
tgt: Amagoro ayio ane nigo arenge ne chibonyi chingare chi'okoondokia, chiaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.

src: not to many peoples of a strange speech and of a hard language, whose words you can't understand. Surely, if I sent you to them, they would listen to you.
tgt: Gose tindi kogotoma ase abanto b'ebisaku ebinge bagokwana emenwa emekong'u, abwo ogokwana kwabo otanyare komanya. Ekeene, onye narenge kogotoma gochia ase abanto buna abwo, nigo barenge gokoigwera.

src: Sikukutuma kwa mataifa mengi yenye maneno ya kutatiza na lugha ngumu ambao maneno yao hutayaelewa. Hakika ningekutuma kwa watu hao, wangekusikiliza.
tgt: Gose tindi kogotoma ase abanto b'ebisaku ebinge bagokwana emenwa emekong'u, abwo ogokwana kwabo otanyare komanya. Ekeene, onye narenge kogotoma gochia ase abanto buna abwo, nigo barenge gokoigwera.

src: The children of the Kenite, Moses' brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
tgt: Abanto b'ororeeria rw'oyomo bw'Abaakeni, ise biara Musa, bakageenda amo n'Abayuda korwa ase Omochie bw'Emekendo gochia erooro, Irianyi y'Aradi, ase ense ya Yuda, na bakamenya ase egati y' abanto b'aroro.

src: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for it was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.
tgt: Omorwoti akagenda Gibeoni gochia korua ekeng’wanso aroro, ekiagera nao egesasiimero kiareenge aase aimokererete igoro mono; akarua aroro ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa elifu eyemo.

src: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
tgt: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!

src: Kwa mwimbishaji. Zaburi ya Daudi. Ee Bwana, nimekukimbilia wewe, usiache nikaaibika kamwe, kwa haki yako uniokoe.
tgt: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!

src: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living, so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those slain by the sword, declares the Lord GOD.”
tgt: “Inche nigo naete Farao ribaga arente obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo; ase ayio ere amo nomoganda oye bwonsi barare ase egati y’abatarogeti, abwo baitetwe nemioro. Nabo Omonene atebiire.”

src: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.
tgt: Barabwo mbabeeke ase emetwe yabo ebitambaa biroisirie korwa ase egatani, naende babeeke chisirwari chi’egatani; tibakweboeria kende gionsi keragere bagiramore.

src: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
tgt: Gaki rende, Omoyahudi inki abuete abande? Na okwaroka inki kogwenerete?

src: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
tgt: Omonto okogechigwa bwango nigo agokora ay'oboriri, na omonto okoroberia ay'obobe nigo akogechwa.

src: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
tgt: Bagatianania ng'a monto onde bwensi orenge kwanga korigia Omonene, Nyasae bw'Abaisraeli, goika aitwe akwe, abe omwana gose omonto omonene, omosacha gose omokungu.

src: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

tgt: Obadia, mosinto o Semaya o Galali, o Yedutuni; na Berekia, mosinto bw’Asa bw’Elikana, oyomenyete ase emechie y’Abaanetofa. Abarendi b’ebiita bie Hekalu abamenyete Yerusalemu

src: So the LORD let him alone. (When she said, “bridegroom of blood,” she was referring to the circumcision.) The People Believe Moses and Aaron
tgt: Agw’Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateeba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”

src: Menahem exacted the money from Israel, even from all the mighty men of wealth, from each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and didn't stay there in the land.
tgt: Menahemu akarusia chitaabu echio buna ebango korwa ase Abaisraeli abaarenge abanda; kera oyomo obo akarua chisekeli chi'echifeta emerongo etano. Chibesa echi akaa omorwoti bw'Abaasuri. Ase ayio omorwoti bw'Abaasuri akairana tamenya ase ense eria.

src: Furthermore, who can understand how the clouds spread out, how the thunder roars from His pavilion?
tgt: Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?

src: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers' households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.
tgt: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Yeria nere otenenerete abanto be chiamate chionsi chi'ororeria rwa Heburoni. (Ase omwaka bw'emerongo ene bw'okogamba gwa Daudi, obotuki bogakorwa, na abanto be chiamate echio abamanyete korwana esegi buya bakanyorekana agwo Yaeseri ya Gileadi).

src: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
tgt: Ekero akwanete aya, kobarigereretie, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, riire rikamoira korwa ase amaiso abo.

src: But they will maintain the fabric of the age. Their prayer is in the handiwork of their craft.
tgt: Tibakonyara gotebereria okonachwa ebiina okwo gose tibana kororekana bagokwana emereng'anio.

src: Lakini watadumisha muundo wa enzi hii. Sala yao iko katika kazi ya mikono ya ufundi wao.
tgt: Tibakonyara gotebereria okonachwa ebiina okwo gose tibana kororekana bagokwana emereng'anio.

src: Then the men of Israel turned back on them, and the men of Benjamin were terrified when they realized that disaster had come upon them.
tgt: Erio Abaisraeli bakaonchoka, bakairana, n’Ababenjamini bagasogwa nomoondoko, ekiagera nigo barooche ng’a ogosirigwa kwabo kwabaacheire ang’e.

src: At daybreak the apostles entered the temple courts as they had been told and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they convened the Sanhedrin —the full assembly of the elders of Israel—and sent to the jail for the apostles.

src: But Naboth replied, “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.”
tgt: Korende Naboti akamoteebia: “Tiga Omonene atange amang’ana ayio, timbaisa gokoa omwando one naetwe ne chisokoro chiane.”

src: Lakini Nabothi akamjibu, “ Bwana na apishe mbali kukupa wewe urithi wa baba zangu.”
tgt: Korende Naboti akamoteebia: “Tiga Omonene atange amang’ana ayio, timbaisa gokoa omwando one naetwe ne chisokoro chiane.”

src: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.
tgt: Naende nyomba ime aborokigwa bakabooria Yeso engencho ye ring'ana erio.

src: Therefore, my brothers, whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you must stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

src: Kwa hiyo, ndugu zangu, ninaowapenda na ambao ninawaonea shauku, ninyi mlio furaha yangu na taji yangu, hivi ndivyo iwapasavyo kusimama imara katika Bwana, ninyi wapenzi wangu. Mausia
tgt: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogooko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong’u ase Omonene, abanchi baane. Ogosorora

src: No longer will a fool be called noble, nor a scoundrel be respected.
tgt: Ase engaki eyio omonto omoriri takorokwa omosike, gose omong’ainereria takorokwa omonto omwegenwa.

src: In the resurrection, people will neither marry nor be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like the angels in heaven.
tgt: Inaki ase okobokigwa tibakonyuoma gose tibakonyuomwa, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika ba Nyasae bare igoro.

src: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, with a strong hand, an outstretched arm, and outpoured wrath I will rule over you.
tgt: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteeba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, nindambore okoboko kwane kore nokobua na ning’umore ekeririanda kiane, nimbe nkobagambera inwe.

src: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
tgt: Elihorefu na Ahiya, basinto ba Sisa, nabwo baarenge abariki. Yehosafati, mosinto bw'Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw'amang'ana are gokoreka.

src: Elihorefu na Ahiya, wana wa Shisha: waandishi; Yehoshafati mwana wa Ahiludi: karani;

src: They can't show signs in the heavens among the nations, or shine as the sun, or give light as the moon.

src: Hawawezi kuonyesha ishara mbinguni miongoni mwa mataifa, wala kung'aa kama jua, wala kutoa nuru kama mwezi.

src: But you will be called Yahweh's priests. Men will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the wealth of the nations. You will boast in their glory.
tgt: Inwe nigo morarokwe abakuani ba Omonene; abanto mbaabaroke abakoreri ba Nyasae oito, moegwe morie obotenenku bw'abaanto b'ebisaku, na gwetogeria obonene obwo bwabo.

src: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?
tgt: Naki omonto oyomo arakore aseerie abanto elifu eyemo, na abanto babere baseerie abanto chilifu ikomi, onye oria ore egetare kiabo atabaoonetie na kobarua, naende onye Omonene tabatigete?

src: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
tgt: “Omonto karaake omonto onde asarie omobere oye, buna omonto oria akorera oyonde, nere naboigo arakorerwe.

src: On the seventh day the priest is to reexamine him, and if he sees that the infection is unchanged and has not spread on the skin, the priest must isolate him for another seven days.
tgt: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa, erio amobeeke naende ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.

src: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.
tgt: Nigo ngokwana ring’ana eri, ng’a monto onde tacha kobang’aina ase amang’ana okoebereria neisa koba nigo bare abaya.

src: Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen. He had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
tgt: Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane (1,400), ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, na echinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu, ang'e nase omorwoti amenyete.

src: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
tgt: Omonene, naye okogamba na konachera abanto bonsi ekiina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekiina koreng'ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.

src: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
tgt: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

src: Wewe ndiwe Mungu utendaye miujiza, umeonyesha uwezo wako katikati ya mataifa.
tgt: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya Mwanyabaanto.

src: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

tgt: Narengeo omonto ore korokwa Baraba, osibetwe amo nabaanto abakorete eburuburu, na gokora oboiti ase eburuburu.

src: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

tgt: Ring'ana ri'Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamoteebia,

tgt: Bonsi bagaichorwa n'Omoika Omochenu, bagachaaka gokwana ase emenwa emeao, buna Omoika obaete gwatora.

src: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’
tgt: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.

src: ‘ Bwana alishindwa kuwaingiza watu hawa katika nchi aliyowaahidi kwa kiapo; hivyo akawaua jangwani.’
tgt: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.

src: When Jesus had finished saying these things, He left Galilee and went into the region of Judea beyond the Jordan.
tgt: Ekero Yeso achia gokoora gokwana amang’ana ayio, akarua Galili, agasoa ensemo ya Boyahudi ng’umbu ya Yorodani;

src: You marched across the earth with fury; You threshed the nations in wrath.
tgt: Aye nigo gwaetete ase ense kore nekeririanda, okamionogorera abanto b’ebisaku inse kore nendamwamu.

src: They were very afraid when they heard that the king had given him authority to gather together an army.
tgt: Abanto abwo bakairoka mono ekero baigwete buna omorwoti omoeire Yonathani okobua gwokoroisia ekeombe kia abarwani be esegi.

src: Waliogopa sana waliposikia kwamba mfalme alikuwa amempa mamlaka ya kukusanya jeshi.
tgt: Abanto abwo bakairoka mono ekero baigwete buna omorwoti omoeire Yonathani okobua gwokoroisia ekeombe kia abarwani be esegi.

src: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, “Oh, don't do this abominable thing that I hate.”
tgt: “Korende nonya naboigo, inche nigo nagendererete gotoma abasomba baane ababani kobateebia: Timobaisa gokora amang'ana 'okogechia aya inche Omonene ngechete.

src: Tena na tena, niliwatuma watumishi wangu manabii ambao walisema, ‘Msifanye jambo hili la kuchukiza ambalo nalichukia!'
tgt: “Korende nonya naboigo, inche nigo nagendererete gotoma abasomba baane ababani kobateebia: Timobaisa gokora amang'ana 'okogechia aya inche Omonene ngechete.

src: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
tgt: Oborwoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.

src: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked, “Lord, who is it?”
tgt: Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamobooria, “Omonene, ning’o?”

src: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
tgt: Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.

src: They dress the wound of My people with very little care, saying, ‘Peace, peace,’ when there is no peace at all.
tgt: Batubire amaote ’abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.

src: Wanafunga majeraha ya watu wangu bila uangalifu. Wanasema, ‘Amani, amani,’ wakati hakuna amani.
tgt: Batubire amaote ’abaanto baane rioka, bagoteeba: Omorembe, omorembe, na omorembe tori aande.

src: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him Yahweh had given victory to Syria; he was also a mighty man of valor, but he was a leper.
tgt: Naamani, omochiki bw'abasikari b'omorwoti bw'Abasiiria, nigo arenge omonto bw'engencho enene ase obosio bw'omonene oye, na omonene oye nigo amosigete mono, ekiagera ase engencho ya Naamani Omonene aete Abasiiria obobui. Ere nigo arenge omonto etuoni y'esegi, korende oborwaire bwa ukoma mbwamoriete.

tgt: Ase ayio Elija akagenda kweorokia ase Ahabu. Engaki eria enchara nigo yarenge endoro se agwo Samaria.

src: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

src: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.

tgt: Abakalidayo bakabuna chisiiro chie chitaai chiria chiarenge ime ase enyomba y'Omonene, na ebibekerero bi'ebituba, na egetuba keria ekenene mono kiaroisirie korwa ase etai ebiarenge ase enyomba y'Omonene. Kobabibunire bikaba ebing'ese, bakaira etai eria yonsi Babiloni.

tgt: Boigo nakwanete emereng’anio chilifu isato; na amatera aye nigo areenge elifu eyemo, na atano.

tgt: Na omomalaika onde agasoka korwa ase Hekalu ya igoro, nere boigo narenge nomoyio okogesa.

tgt: abogorie ensemo y'ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudasi atigete, akagenda aase aye.”

tgt: Erio Saitani akairaneri’Omonene, akamoteebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.

src: The singers also praised him with their voices. There was a sweet melody in the whole house.
tgt: Abateeri boigo bakamotogia ase amariogi abo, ase chingeero chingiya na amariogi areng'anaine buya.

src: For Jozacar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, struck him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in David's city; and Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
tgt: Abasomba baye, Yosakari, mosinto o Simeati, na Yehosabadi, mosinto o Someri, aba nabwo bamoitete agakwa. Yoashi agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe agwo ase Omochie o Daudi, na Amasia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

src: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

tgt: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudasi Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,

src: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.
tgt: Korende ogoakwa kw'amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw'amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang'ana onsi, naende kore ogw'ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.

src: Nanyi, upako mlioupata kutoka kwake unakaa ndani yenu, wala ninyi hamna haja ya mtu yeyote kuwafundisha. Lakini kama vile upako wake unavyowafundisha kuhusu mambo yote nayo ni kweli wala si uongo, basi kama ulivyowafundisha kaeni ndani yake.
tgt: Korende ogoakwa kw'amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw'amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang'ana onsi, naende kore ogw'ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.

src: Consider, then, the parable of the sower:
tgt: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw’omobusuri.

src: “Sikilizeni basi maana ya ule mfano wa mpanzi:
tgt: “Gaki, igwa omobayeeno bw’omobusuri.

src: He measured the length and width of the gate of the outer court which faces toward the north.
tgt: Naende akagenda ase oboagacho bware geita ki'eraaro ya isiko kiarochie sugusu, na akarengia obotambe na obogare bwaye.

src: But rebels and sinners will together be shattered, and those who forsake the LORD will perish.
tgt: Korende abasaria na abanyabibe nigo barasirigwe amo; na abwo batigire Omonene mbasirigwe boigo.

src: Then Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jehoiakim and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
tgt: Nebukadinesaro, omorwoti o Babiloni, agacha akarwana nere, akamobwata akamosiba ne chingataare, akamoira Babiloni.

src: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let's exalt his name together.
tgt: Raria obonene bw'Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.

src: Mtukuzeni Bwana pamoja nami, naam, na tulitukuze jina lake pamoja.
tgt: Raria obonene bw'Omonene amo nainche totogie erieta riaye twensi amo.

src: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
tgt: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, nigo 'nkogoakera ng'a mbuya mono n'enkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.

src: Zaburi ya Daudi. Nitakusifu wewe, Ee Bwana, kwa moyo wangu wote, mbele ya “miungu” nitaimba sifa zako.
tgt: (Ogoteera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, nigo 'nkogoakera ng'a mbuya mono n'enkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.

src: Aren't you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed them for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
tgt: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikiire batogambie ekiina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki'ogotorongeyia.

src: Ee Bwana, je, wewe sio wa tangu milele? Mungu wangu, Uliye Mtakatifu wangu, hatutakufa. Ee Bwana, umewachagua wao ili watekeleze hukumu; Ee Mwamba, umewaamuru watuadhibu.
tgt: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, Omochenu one, tari aye oreo korwa kare na kare? Ase ayio titogokwa. Aye Omonene, egetare giaito, aye kwabachikiire batogambie ekiina, kwababekire batoe egesusuro ki'ogotorongeyia.

src: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
tgt: Omogambi otari n'obong'aini nigo are omochaandi omotindi, korende oria ogechete okonyora ebitooki bitari bi'oboronge, nigo akogeenderera kogamba ase amatuko amaange.

src: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
tgt: Nigo bang’umokerete buna chinchoke, korende bakarima buna omorero bw’amagwa; ase erieta ri’Omonene ’nkabasiria.

src: (now the congregation's half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
tgt: nigo kiarenge ching'ondi chilifu amagana atato, emerongo etato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (337,500),

src: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'
tgt: ekiagera omosani one ochire ase 'nde korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;

src: Kwa sababu rafiki yangu amekuja kutoka safarini, nami sina kitu cha kumpa.'
tgt: ekiagera omosani one ochire ase 'nde korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;

src: However, from the beginning of creation, ‘God made them male and female.’
tgt: Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.

src: Lakini tangu mwanzo wa uumbaji, ‘Mungu aliwaumba mwanaume na mwanamke.
tgt: Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.

src: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
tgt: Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye igo yarenge ang'e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng'a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,

src: You have granted me life and loving devotion, and Your care has preserved my spirit.
tgt: Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.

src: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn't fear Yahweh. Therefore Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
tgt: Na ekaba ase omochakano obo bw'okomenya aroro tibamoirogete Omonene; ase ayio Omonene agatoma chindo ase egati yabo, chigaita abanto bande babo.

src: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.
tgt: Naende korwa ase okoruegwa okwo aimokie goke, goichire roe, kobe ekeinyorio ng'a okoruegwa okwo nokwa Omonene, na kogosambera ase egesasiimero, na magega y'ayio ae omokungu oria amaache aria anywe.

src: Kisha kuhani atachota sadaka ya nafaka mkono uliojaa kama sehemu ya kumbukumbu na kuiteketeza juu ya madhabahu, baada ya hayo, atamtaka huyo mwanamke anywe yale maji.
tgt: Naende korwa ase okoruegwa okwo aimokie goke, goichire roe, kobe ekeinyorio ng'a okoruegwa okwo nokwa Omonene, na kogosambera ase egesasiimero, na magega y'ayio ae omokungu oria amaache aria anywe.

src: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
tgt: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mok'aye ase ring'ana rinde rionsi?”

src: And the people to whom they prophesy will be thrown into the streets of Jerusalem because of famine and sword. There will be no one to bury them or their wives, their sons or their daughters. I will pour out their own evil upon them.
tgt: Abanto baabaaneirwe nababani abwo, mbakwe nenchara, nabaitwe nemioro, batugutwe ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, na monto onde tari orabatindeke. Abakungu babo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabakorwe boigo. Naboigo ndabairanerie amabe abo.”

src: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
tgt: “Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.

src: So Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau. Esau Marries Mahalath
tgt: Naboigo Isaka agateebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng’ina Yakobo na Esau. Esau okonyuoma omokungu onde

src: Kisha Isaki akamuaga Yakobo, naye akaenda Padan-Aramu, kwa Labani mwana wa Bethueli Mwaramu, ndugu wa Rebeka, aliyekuwa mama wa Yakobo na Esau.
tgt: Naboigo Isaka agateebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng’ina Yakobo na Esau. Esau okonyuoma omokungu onde

src: And Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the days he was instructed by Jehoiada the priest.
tgt: Yoashi agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi, ekiagera Yehoyada Omokuani abeete okomosemia.

src: If you lend money to one of My people among you who is poor, you must not act as a creditor to him; you are not to charge him interest.
tgt: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.

src: After the priests and Levites had purified themselves, they purified the people, the gates, and the wall.
tgt: Abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, bagachena nabaanto bonsi amo nebiita, na orwaki roria.

src: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.
tgt: Okoiborwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo kwarenge iga: Ekero Mariamu ng'ina konya ariereirwe boko na Yusufu, na konya bataramenyana buna omosacha n'omokuungu, Mariamu akarorekana ore morito ase chinguru chi'Omoika Omochenu.

src: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
tgt: Ning'o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?

src: These are the inheritances, which Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the children of Israel, distributed for inheritance by lot in Shiloh before Yahweh, at the door of the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
tgt: Eyio nero emiando Eleazari, Omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi'ebisaku bi'Abaisraeli, baatananete ase ogoaka obomera aria Silo, ase okobori'Omonene, ase egesoero ki'Eema y'Omosangererekano. Nabo bagakoora emeremo y'ogwatanana ense eria.

src: The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.
tgt: Egetare ekemo nigo giachongororogete ensemo ya sugusu kororia Mikimasi, na ekende ensemo ya Irianyi kororia Geba.

src: Jabali moja lilisimama kaskazini kuelekea Mikmashi na jingine upande wa kusini kuelekea Geba.
tgt: Egetare ekemo nigo giachongororogete ensemo ya sugusu kororia Mikimasi, na ekende ensemo ya Irianyi kororia Geba.

src: On the seventh day, the king came to mourn for Daniel. When he came to the den, he looked in, and, behold, Daniel was sitting.
tgt: Erio omorwoti agaaka eriogi okobora; Aye Omonene Nyasae o Danieli, aye naye Nyasae Omonene naende onde taiyo Omonene gokobua aye.

src: Siku ya saba, mfalme alikuja kumwombolezea Danieli. Alipofika kwenye tundu, akatazama ndani, na tazama, Danieli alikuwa ameketi.
tgt: Erio omorwoti agaaka eriogi okobora; Aye Omonene Nyasae o Danieli, aye naye Nyasae Omonene naende onde taiyo Omonene gokobua aye.

src: And Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. And his son Zechariah reigned in his place.
tgt: Yeroboamu akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiarenge abarwoti b’Abaisraeli chiararete. Na Zakaria, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

src: Yeroboamu akalala pamoja na baba zake, wafalme wa Israeli. Naye Zekaria mwanawe akawa mfalme baada yake.
tgt: Yeroboamu akaraara ase chisokoro chiaye chiarenge abarwoti b’Abaisraeli chiararete. Na Zakaria, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogaamba ase ribaga riaye.

src: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Moab, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime;
tgt: Aya naro Omonene ateebire: “Ase engencho y'ogosaria kw' abanto ba Moabu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo basambete amauga 'omorwoti o Edomu akaba ribu.

src: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
tgt: Akamoteebia, “Toteebia monto onde ing'ana, korende genda, bweorokie ase Omokuani, orue ekeng'wanso ase ogosibeka kwao buna Musa achiigete, kebe kirori ase abanto.”

src: “Son of man,” He said to me, “now lift up your eyes to the north.” So I lifted up my eyes to the north, and in the entrance north of the Altar Gate I saw this idol of jealousy.
tgt: Erio Omonene aganteebia, “Aye Mwanyabaanto, imokia amaiso ao igoro, origererie gochia sugusu.” Ase ayio nkarigereria gochia sugusu, nkarora omogwekano bw’ogosasiimwa, oria obogetie risemi ria Nyasae oteneine ensemo ya sugusu y’egesoero ki’egeita kegochia ase egesasiimero.

src: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
tgt: Ekero konya Tera aikire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani.

src: Tera alipokuwa na miaka sabini, akamzaa Abramu, Nahori na Harani.
tgt: Ekero konya Tera aikire emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani.

src: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
tgt: na origereretie goocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.

src: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hands of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye.
tgt: Na Zedekia, omorwoti bw’Abayuda, tagotooreka korwa ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, korende ekeene, goika abekwe ase okoboko kw’omorwoti o Babiloni, akwane nere obosio ase obosio, na kororana nere amaiso ase amaiso.

src: But Amaziah would not listen. So Jehoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.
tgt: Korende Amasia tanchete gotegerera. Ase ayio Yehoasi, omorwoti bw'Abaisraeli, akagenda koumerana nere, na igo ere na Amasia, omorwoti bw'Abayuda, bakarigererania obosio ase obosio ase okorwana esegi agwo Beti‐Semesi, omochie bw'Abayuda.

src: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
tgt: Magega ye chinsa isato mokaye agasoa, ere tamanyete aya akoregete.

src: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,
tgt: Inaki Nyasae, oyo 'ngokorera ase omoika one korandia enchiri y'Omwana oye, nere kirori one ng'a tintigeti kobaatora botambe ase ogosaba kwane.

src: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,
tgt: Ekero Mikaya mosinto o Gema ria, omochokoro o Safani, aigwete amang’ana ayio onsi ay’Omonene ariikire ase egetabu eria,

src: So he went with them. When they came to the Jordan, they cut down wood.
tgt: Ase ayio akagenda amo nabarabwo, na ekero baigete Yorodani, bakagecha emete.

src: Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”
tgt: Omonene aganteebia, “Genda omwanche naende omokungu oyio nonya ogokora obotomani nomwanchi oye, omwanche buna Omonene anchete Abaisraeli, nonya baonchokeire chinyasae ching'ao, naende babeire n'okogania kwa amasabibu amomo.”

src: Bwana akaniambia, “Nenda, ukaonyeshe upendo wako kwa mke wako tena, ingawa amependwa na mwingine naye ni mzinzi. Mpende kama Bwana apendavyo Waisraeli, ingawa wanageukia miungu mingine na kupenda mikate mitamu ya zabibu kavu iliyowekwa wakfu.”
tgt: Omonene aganteebia, “Genda omwanche naende omokungu oyio nonya ogokora obotomani nomwanchi oye, omwanche buna Omonene anchete Abaisraeli, nonya baonchokeire chinyasae ching'ao, naende babeire n'okogania kwa amasabibu amomo.”

src: For if you remain silent now, then relief and deliverance will come to the Jews from another place, but you and your father's house will perish. Who knows if you haven't come to the kingdom for such a time as this?”
tgt: Naki onye aye kogokira‐kiri kegima ase engaki eye, ogokonywa na ogotooreka nigo korache ase Abayahudi korwa ensemo ende, korende aye na abanto b'enyomba ya iso mosirigwe. Ande, ning'o omanyete gose nase engencho y'engaki buna eye kwabeire eting'ana y'omorwoti?”

src: Jerusalem, Idumea, the region beyond the Jordan, and the vicinity of Tyre and Sidon. The large crowd came to Him when they heard what great things He was doing.
tgt: na Yerusalemu, na Idumea, na ng’umbu ya Yorodani, ne chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni okabatunyana. Ochia koigwa ebirage bi’amang’ana onsi arenge gokora, omoganda oyio omonene, okamochiera.

src: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
tgt: Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.

src: In a congregation of sinners, a fire will be kindled. In a disobedient nation, wrath is kindled.
tgt: Omorero n'outwe gati y'erisango ri'abaanto abanyabibe, gose obororo ng'a boitekere abaenenu.

src: Katika kusanyiko la wenye dhambi, moto utawaka. Katika taifa lisilotii, ghadhabu itawaka.
tgt: Omorero n'outwe gati y'erisango ri'abaanto abanyabibe, gose obororo ng'a boitekere abaenenu.

src: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
tgt: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae ase ekegambero?

src: He counted them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
tgt: Ekero Saulo abarete Abaisraeli agwo Bezeki, nigo baarenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), na Abayuda chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

src: Sauli alipowakusanya huko Bezeki, watu wa Israeli walikuwa 300,000 na watu wa Yuda 30,000.
tgt: Ekero Saulo abarete Abaisraeli agwo Bezeki, nigo baarenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), na Abayuda chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).

src: He does not eat at the mountain or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor’s wife.
tgt: Ere taria ebing’wanso bikoruerwa ase ebitunwa igoro, gose tarigereria emegwekano y’Abaisraeli bagosasiima, gose takora obonyaka n’omokuungu bw’omonto onde;

src: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,
tgt: Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare n'enchara; barabwo bakaagaacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.

src: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
tgt: Abana abamura ba Ketura, omokungu o sere‐sere o Aburaamu, nabwo aba: Simurani na Yokisani, Medani na Midiani, Isibaki na Sua. Abana abamura ba Yokisani nabwo Seba na Dedani.

src: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
tgt: Yusufu akaa ise amo na bamura bamwabo aase bakomenya, akabaa Ramesesi, orogongo oruya, ensemo engiya mono y'ense eria, buna Farao achiigete.

src: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
tgt: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang'e ne rigoko ri'Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,

src: Eneo lao lilienea toka Aroeri, iliyoko ukingoni mwa Bonde la Arnoni kuanzia mji ulio katikati ya bonde, likijumlisha nchi ya uwanda wa juu wote wa Medeba mpaka Diboni,
tgt: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang'e ne rigoko ri'Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,

src: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia's house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.
tgt: Na barabwo bagasooka korwa ase echela, bagasoa nyomba mwa Lidia. Aroro bakanyorana nabamwabo, bakabaremia. Erio bakaimoka, bakagenda.

src: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying:
tgt: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, Omotisibi, rigateeba,

src: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.
tgt: Nyasae one nigo agonchichera nobwanchani bwaye botari koera, Nyasae one nankore nchenge igoro y'ababisa baane.

src: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
tgt: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba ase amagoro aane; ong’iranirie magega; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru nde n’obororo omobaso boira.

src: “Kutoka juu alipeleka moto, akaushusha katika mifupa yangu. Aliitandia wavu miguu yangu na akanirudisha nyuma. Akanifanya mkiwa, na mdhaifu mchana kutwa.
tgt: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba ase amagoro aane; ong’iranirie magega; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru nde n’obororo omobaso boira.

src: I will feed them in good pasture, and the lofty mountains of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in a good grazing land; they will feed in rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

src: Then the young man said to the angel, “Brother Azarias, I have heard that this maid has been given to seven men, and that they all perished in the bride-chamber.

src: For we don't stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn't reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,
tgt: Naki titori gwekinia intwe abanyene goetania ekerengo giaito buna ntotari kobaikera inwe. Naki intwe nabatang'ani tore b'okobarentera inwe enchiri ya Kristo.

src: Or it is like when a bird flies through the air, no evidence of its passage is found, but the light wind, lashed with the stroke of its pinions, and torn apart with the violent rush of the moving wings, is passed through. Afterwards no sign of its coming remains.
tgt: Gose buna enyoni ekoiruruka ase embeo etari gotiga kemanyererio kende gionsi ase egoetera; ero nigo egoaka aka embeo inke inke ase chimbaba chiaye, ero nigo egoeta ase embeo korende teri gotiga kemanyererio ase yaetire.

src: Au ni kama ndege anaporuka angani, hakuna ushahidi wa kupita kwake unaopatikana, lakini upepo mwepesi, unaopigwa kwa mapigo ya mabawa yake, na kupasuka kwa mshindo mkali wa mabawa yanayotembea, hupitishwa. Baadaye hakuna dalili ya kuja kwake iliyobaki.
tgt: Gose buna enyoni ekoiruruka ase embeo etari gotiga kemanyererio kende gionsi ase egoetera; ero nigo egoaka aka embeo inke inke ase chimbaba chiaye, ero nigo egoeta ase embeo korende teri gotiga kemanyererio ase yaetire.

src: The whole assembly who had returned from exile made booths and lived in them. From the days of Joshua son of Nun until that day, the Israelites had not celebrated like this. And there was great rejoicing.

src: God thunders wondrously with His voice; He does great things we cannot comprehend.
tgt: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.

src: So the disciples went and did as Jesus had directed them.

src: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
